cases.sentence: ___, которого любил Иисус, сказал тогда Петру, «Это Господь».
cases.translation: The disciple whom Jesus loved said then to Peter, 'It is the Lord.'
cases.explain: Ученик is the subject of the verb сказал (said), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: This was by the Sea of Tiberias.
cases.explain: The preposition у (by/at) governs the genitive case, so море becomes моря.

cases.sentence: Ученик, которого любил Иисус, сказал тогда ___, «Это Господь».
cases.translation: The disciple whom Jesus loved said then to Peter, 'It is the Lord.'
cases.explain: The verb сказал (said) takes an indirect object in the dative case — said TO Peter.

cases.translation: 'I am going to catch fish,' said Simon Peter.
cases.explain: The transitive verb ловить (to catch) takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он обвязался верхней ___, так как был раздет, и прыгнул в воду.
cases.translation: He wrapped himself with his outer garment, since he was undressed, and jumped into the water.
cases.explain: The reflexive verb обвязаться (to wrap oneself) governs the instrumental case for the thing used to wrap.

cases.sentence: Рано утром Иисус стоял на ___, но ученики не узнали его.
cases.translation: Early in the morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize him.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on), indicating location, governs the prepositional (locative) case: на берегу.

reading.ru: Симон Петр, Фома, называемый Близнец, Нафанаил из Каны Галилейской, сыновья Зеведея и два других ученика собрались вместе.
reading.question: Who gathered together at the Sea of Tiberias?
options: Simon Peter, Thomas, Nathanael, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples
All twelve apostles plus Mary Magdalene
Nathanael and the sons of Zebedee alone
reading.correct: Simon Peter, Thomas, Nathanael, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples
reading.explain: The text lists Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples as being together.

reading.ru: Они отплыли на лодке, но в ту ночь ничего не поймали.
reading.question: What happened when the disciples went out fishing that night?
reading.explain: The text states they sailed out in the boat but caught nothing that night.

reading.ru: Он сказал, «забросьте сеть с правого борта и поймайте».
reading.question: What did Jesus instruct the disciples to do?
options: Cast the net on the right side of the boat
Cast the net on the left side
reading.correct: Cast the net on the right side of the boat
reading.explain: Jesus told them to cast the net on the right side of the boat and they would catch fish.

reading.ru: Как только Петр услышал, что это Господь, он обвязался верхней одеждой, так как был раздет, и прыгнул в воду.
reading.question: What did Peter do as soon as he heard it was the Lord?
options: He put on his outer garment and jumped into the water
He stayed in the boat and waited
He asked Jesus for proof first
reading.correct: He put on his outer garment and jumped into the water
reading.explain: Peter wrapped himself in his outer garment, since he was undressed, and jumped into the sea.

reading.ru: В ней было 153 большие рыбы, однако сеть не порвалась.
reading.question: How many fish were caught in the net, and what happened to the net?
options: 153 fish, and the net did not tear
200 fish, and the net did not tear
reading.correct: 153 fish, and the net did not tear
reading.explain: The text says the net held 153 large fish yet did not tear.

reading.question: What did Jesus tell Peter to do after Peter's first affirmation of love?
reading.explain: After Peter said he loved Jesus the first time, Jesus told him, 'Then feed my lambs.'

reading.ru: Петр опечалился, что Иисус спросил его в третий раз, «Любишь ли ты меня?»
reading.question: How did Peter feel when Jesus asked him a third time whether he loved him?
reading.explain: The text says Peter was grieved that Jesus asked him a third time whether he loved him.

reading.ru: Но когда состаришься, то протянешь руки, и другой подпояшет тебя и поведет туда, куда ты не захочешь».
reading.question: What did Jesus say would happen to Peter when he grew old?
options: Another would dress him and lead him where he did not want to go
He would become a fisherman again
reading.correct: Another would dress him and lead him where he did not want to go
reading.explain: Jesus said that when Peter grew old, another would dress him and carry him where he did not wish to go.

reading.ru: Он и есть тот ученик, который свидетельствует об этом, и который это записал.
reading.question: Who is identified as the one who testifies about these events and wrote them down?
reading.explain: The closing verses identify the disciple whom Jesus loved as the one who testifies and wrote these things.
